payload.text: ISSUE:0012 (low): r in the Herdr panel forces a fetch. On hv's decision 18 and vc's brief, for 0.1.11. The first build landed as 4930094, but hv's look failed: r did nothing. The panel never held the keyboard, because its root had no focus handle, so neither on_key_down nor hv's "mod:ccusage" section in keys.json could reach it. The fix, on vc's brief of 2026-11-17: the panel takes the keyboard as Herdr's own mods do (cx.focus_handle tracked on its root, focused on open, on click and on focus, with mod.json focusable) and handles r itself, so r needs no keys.json line; the docs drop the keys.json step. Branch ic/ISSUE-0012-focus in /Users/matts/Devel/scratch/ccusage-ic/wt-issue-0012-focus, 25be3e0 on d761f80. Green in Desk slot 01M7M9NAJ6B7A00WE74BN7ZB4A (08:23:51Z to 08:24:08Z), with herdr-app check passing on the new main.js and mod.json; handed to vc, and hv looks again from that build (/Users/matts/Devel/scratch/ccusage-ic/target/release/ccusage, 0.1.10 dev 25be3e0dfa39), which stays as it is until the look is done. vc asked hv to remove the mod:ccusage section.
